pronunciation: tee-ow mee (with a falling-then-level feel on 'mee')

example.english: The old man is selling rice at the market.

note: Hakka distinguishes buying grain (糴 tha̍k) from selling it (糶 tiau), a pair that has merged in Mandarin. Rice is central to Hakka cooking and farming life, so these old, specific verbs survive.
